I am farming a small rented plot of beans here in Kagera. Money is tight because the land is not mine, so I cannot spend much on chemical fertilizer — maybe I will try a little if I can get some from a neighbor, but mostly I will rely on manure from the few animals around and the legumes themselves which help the soil. I will use seeds I saved from last season and intercrop with bananas and maybe maize as we always do. I will work the plot myself with help from my family, and only hire someone for a day or two at weeding time if the rains are heavy.
